subject: reasoning
question: If A + B means that A is the father of B, A ÷ B means that A is the mother of B, A × B means that A is the brother of B then which of the following expression shows that Q is the sister of P?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7594ad387bf4b7588679b7269732a1d39631620e38d42510b7b6dd3e083d7fc7.png] 

**Given:**

 
 

 **Code** 
 **Meaning**
 
 

 A + B
 A is the father of B
 
 

 A ÷ B
 A is the mother of B
 
 

 A × B
 A is the brother of B
 
 

**Given expression:**

Q is the sister of P

**Option 1 : **P × Q + R

P × Q means that P is the brother of Q

Q + R means that Q is the father of R

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/cfc81aac6f5016c5aad702af60eefedc3b31b9509884958e2b4f8de42a523a06.png] 

Here, Q is brother of P.

Option 2 : P + R × Q

P + R means that P is the father of R

R × Q means that R is the brother of Q

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4ad83306fa4cec19d74dc22b3001ac8524e949b16be61514a1acf87cf0ff5d39.png] 

Here gender of Q Unknown.

Option 3 : P × Q ÷ R

P × Q means that P is the brother of Q

Q ÷ R means that Q is the mother of R

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/129ab2d510a14c9f03ea35cda2ccf1a82e6ce81028d22f23d888df2ca069bb35.png] 

Here, Q is the sister of P. So it will be answer.

Option 4 : Q × P ÷ R

Q × P means that Q is the brother of P

P ÷ R means that P is the mother of R

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c6e771096a77c75221837123699ebec49b02952d8cc0ac8368ceb454db6e1391.png] 

Here, Q is the brother P.

Hence, **'Option 3'** is the correct answer.
